title: Sync current RapidRAW: edge-aware tone, Kelvin white balance, fog and relight
notes: RapidRoom #175. Normal merge of 73 incoming commits through upstream eb3556bc (v1.6.5 plus fog, relight and staged spatial previews), preserving contributor history and RapidRoom protections. Guided filtering, shadow/highlight detail reinjection, selective Whites and Kelvin/as-shot A/D65 white balance change rendered output. Library pick/reject actions, three-way rating operators, persisted-write selection advance, curve controls, Czech/Dutch translations and Android fixes carry over. Existing closed-pipe logging, AI tag limits, filter-before-grouping and export-preset fields deduplicate where upstream contains the same fixes. Cloud authentication requires an explicitly saved cloud provider; CPU remains the default, AI-free never mounts Clerk, and telemetry is disabled. Atomic metadata rollback, local HSL exact no-op, independent section visibility, MCP/terminal and Tree denoise remain. The MCP schema accepts the new absolute whiteBalance object while retaining relative offsets. Integration and regression tests written with Codex. Rendering evidence and human review accompany the PR; reference renders remain frozen pending explicit approval. Sony reduced M/S lossless RGB raws use reference WB rather than deriving a false sensor neutral from already-applied unity gains. The pinned RapidRoom decoder retains crop, Sony aspect and scoped ORF/DNG fixes; upstream rawler a32bc1ff E-M1X CFA correction is applied equivalently at native RAW development. WB, HSL and relight placement tools remain mutually exclusive.
